name: Deliberately invalid transonic Cp fallback demonstration
data_origin: SYNTHETIC example. Published M6-inspired planform only; Cp is an analytic mild-recovery curve and is not ONERA test data or CFD. Profiles are generated from the same Thwaites/quartic surrogate as the Cp route and are not independent validation. Surface distance is approximated by x_c times local chord. Initial theta uses an assumed linear stagnation-to-first-point velocity ramp. This negative test changes Mach to 0.84 while retaining the synthetic Cp. It must be rejected by the incompressible boundary-layer fallback.

calibration.notes: Subsonic equiaxed distributed grit; NASA TN D-3579. Mach cap 0.95 is a tool guard.

warnings: Preliminary trip sizing, not a prediction or guarantee of transition or downstream turbulent development.
Only the supplied discrete conditions are covered; no guarantee between sampled angles of attack or Reynolds numbers.
Sweep sets placement geometry only. Crossflow, attachment-line transition, and 3D streamline histories are not solved.
Height is exposed protrusion above the model surface, including mounting effects; verify actual installed height.
Height margin and k/delta99 cap are user design policies, not universal transition correlations.
Cp mode assumes the upstream boundary layer remains laminar unless a known limit is supplied.
Cp mode uses incompressible Thwaites and a reconstructed profile; freestream and upstream local Mach must stay <=0.30.
Angle of attack labels select supplied Cp cases; they do not generate aerodynamic loading.
